tools.name: macro_ensure_project_prerequisites
tools.description:
Macro Tool: Automatically ensures specific Unreal Engine plugins are enabled in the .uproject file.

Use this tool BEFORE building systems that require specific plugins (e.g., EnhancedInput, PCG, CommonUI, GameplayAbilities). If a plugin is already enabled, it does nothing. If it enables a new plugin, it will prompt you to restart the Editor.

plugins.description: List of exact plugin names to enable, e.g. ['EnhancedInput', 'PCG', 'CommonUI', 'GameplayAbilities']
